title: Q-PILOT-first-agreement: First pilot agreement on the bring-your-own-account model
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:business/pilots/pilot-1-agreement.md
**Status:** open

Test hypothesis H1 in doctrine/pilot-model.json: a fixed-fee pilot in the customer's own account with a guaranteed first measured improvement. Record the agreement (terms, fee, success measure) in business/pilots/pilot-1-agreement.md. Signing is the owner's act; the fleet prepares the draft and the success probes.
